name: 45669 · Proctorville, OH
findings: ZIP 45669 (Proctorville) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45669 (Proctorville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
